description: Creator subscription store products. One product per price tier, interval and slot; each product is its own iOS subscription group so a fan can hold several creator subscriptions at once. Generated from services/go/platform/regionpricing/regionPricing.creatorTiers.go and checked by regionPricing.storeProducts_test.go.
priceRule: appMinor = webMinor / (1 - storeFee), rounded up to the regional price point; pick the nearest store price point at or above it

fallbackRegion.note: Every other storefront uses the US tier price, converted by the store
